# Check what the element looks like after attr_list processes it
import markdown
from xml.etree import ElementTree as etree

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])

# Patch AttrListTreeprocessor to see what it does
original_attrlist_run = None
for tp in md.treeprocessors:
    if tp.__class__.__name__ == 'AttrListTreeprocessor':
        original_attrlist_run = tp.run
        break

def debug_attrlist_run(doc):
    result = original_attrlist_run(doc)
    for el in doc.iter():
        if isinstance(el.tag, str) and el.tag.startswith('h'):
            print(f"After attr_list - Header {el.tag}:")
            print(f"  text={el.text!r}")
            print(f"  attrib={dict(el.attrib)}")
    return result

if original_attrlist_run:
    tp.run = debug_attrlist_run

text = "# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}"
result = md.convert(text)
print("\nResult:")
print(result)
